s: Lehizzaher mitztzoa bishat qeriat shema ubo y"a seipim: tzoa baashashit — muttar liqrot kenegdah, ap al pi sheroeh otah derek dopnoteha, lepi shebbetztzoa tala hakkatub bekissuy, shenneemar: "veshabta vekissita et tzeateka", vahare hi mekussa:

Tzoa bagumma — manniach sandal al gabbe haggumma veqore, sheal yede ken chashuba kimkussa. Vehu sheen reach ra maggia elayv, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman a"t. Veen omerim shehassandal batel legabbe raglo veeno chashub kissuy, kemo sheharegel atzmah enah moelet lekassot tzoa shettachteha baggumma, mishshum deen zeh "machaneka qadosh" kevan sheen hepseq kissuy ben gup haadam latztzoa shebbaggumma, ella hassandal hu chashub kissuy vehepseq benehem. Umikkol maqom, batel hu legabbe raglo leinyan shetztzarik shello yihyeh nogea batztzoa shebbagguma, sheim hu nogea bah — yesh lehistappeq velomar shehare zeh keillu nogea beraglo, mippene shehassandal hu tapel umeshammesh leraglo bingia zo, sheharegel nogea batztzoa al yede hassandal, shehi maamida et hassandal al hatztzoa, vachashuba keillu hi atzmah nogaat batztzoa. Veap lehammattirim betzoa al besaro umekussa bebigdo — en hassandal nechshab kissuy latztzoa shealayv, veen zeh "machaneka qadosh". Usepeqa shel tora lechumra. Abal tzoa sheal begadayv mibbipnim, kevan shehu mekusseh bibgadayv — hare zeh "machaneka qadosh". Veen omerim shehabbeged batel legabbe gupo ukeillu gupo nogea batztzoa al yede habbeged, kevan sheen habbeged meshammesh laggup bingia zo shehabbeged nogea batztzoa, kevan sheen reach ra maggia elayv — muttar liqrot ulehitpallel keshehu labush bibgadim elleh. Umikkol maqom middat chasidut lehachalipam bishat hattepilla, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman (tz"a) [tz"ch]:

Tzoa apillu hi oberet, kegon shetztzapa al pene hammayim, o sheechad nose gerap shel rei umaabiro lipne haqqore o hammitpalel — tzarik lehapsiq ad shettaabor mikkeneged panayv d' ammot litzdadin o lepanayv kimlo enayv, kemo betzoa munnachat kemo sheyyitbaer besiman a"t. Lepikak pi chazir asur liqrot qeriat shema kenegdo ap al pi shehu ober, mippene shehu ketzoa oberet. Vaapillu hu oleh min hannahar — en harechitza moelet lo, mippene shehu kigrap shel rei sheasur liqrot kenegdo ap al pi sheen bo rei, hoil vehu meyuchad lekak, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman p"z:

Hayeta tzoa al besaro umekussa bibgadayv apillu habbeged nogea bah, veken im hiknis yado lebet hakkisse veeno meriach reach ra, ukegon sheyyesh mechitztza beno leben mechitztzot bet hakkisse vehiknis yado lebet hakkisse derek chor shebbammechitzot, deim lo ken asur mishshum bet hakkisse atzmo ap al pi sheyyesh lo mechitzot kemo sheyyitbaer besiman p"g, abal akshav sheen leesor ella mishshum hayyad bilbaddah shehi bebet hakkisse, o mishshum oto maqom bibsaro shehatztzoa munnachat alayv tachat begadayv, sheoto maqom en ani qore bo "vehaya machaneka qadosh vego'" — (v)yesh omerim sheen leesor bishbilam liqrot ulehitpallel, shenneemar: "kol hanneshama tehallel yah", happeh vehachotem hem biklal hahillul velo shear ebarim. Veap al pi sheenam neqiyyim — muttar, veyesh oserim, mishshum shenneemar: "kol atzmotay tomarna Hashem mi kamoka". Veyesh omerim shello hittiru hammattirim betzoa sheal besaro ella bemaqom shehi nikset meeleha belo malbush, kegon ben atztzile yadayv. Uleinyan maaseh nakon laasot kedibre haoserim bekol inyan. Vaapillu beshikbat zera sheal besaro — nakon lehachamir bah kemo betzoa ap al pi shehi mekussa bebigdo, ap al pi shemmeiqqar haddin enah ketzoa kelal. Umikkol maqom en tzarik lirchotz bemayim ella im ken hi yebesha kebar, abal im adayin hi lacha meqannechah bemappa vedayyo. Bammeh debarim amurim keshehi al besaro, abal al bigdo umekussa shemmuttar apillu betzoa kemo shennitbaer leel — kol shekken beshikbat zera sheeno ketzoa kelal min haddin. Umikkol maqom miqtzat chasidim harishonim hayu meshammeshim mittotehem arummim, shello tidbaq shikbat zera bachaluqehen, ap al pi shehu mekusseh milmala. Veken hayu machamirim al atzman shello yihyeh al bigdehem apillu tippe meme raglayim, vekol shekken tippot tzoa:
Mi sheyyadayv metunnapot miqqinnuach bet hakkisse, im en bahem mammashut tzoa ella likluk bealma vehi yebesha vehalak rechah — muttar liqrot ap al pi shehi megulla al yadayv:

Tzoa bimqomah haynu beneqeb pi hattabbaat apillu hi mekussa — asur liqrot ledibre hakkol, sheap hammattirim betzoa mekussa al besaro — modim betzoa bimqomah, mippene shezzuhamatah merubba, shechamma hi velo yotza laavir veen rechah mitpazzer. Vehu sheim haya omed hayeta niret, vaapillu lo hayeta niret keshehu omed ella keshehu yosheb. Abal im lo hayeta niret kelal — muttar, mippene shello nittena tora lemalake hashsharet. Vekol zeh leoto adam atzmo, abal acher muttar liqrot etzlo keshehu mekusseh bibgadayv:

Mi sheyyesh lo choli hattechorim vezab mimmennu dam tamid, veaggab haddam yotze mimmennu lecha serucha umeuppeshet veyesh lah reach ra — asur bekol dabar shebbiqdushsha kol zeman shelecha serucha shotet mimmennu. Veim en sham reach ra, im haddam o hallecha yotze bederek dechiyya beserugin — min hammeayim hem, veyesh lo taqqana lirchotz meqom hazzuhama. Veim shotet veyoredet tamid meatzmah shello bederek dechiyya — mippi hattabbaat hi, veen tzarik taqqana dahave kedam makkato:

Haya lepanayv meat tzoa — yakol lebattelah beroq sheyyaroq bah veyiqra. Vehu sheyyihyeh haroq abeh, shello tehe hatztzoa niret. Veken mayim sheal gabbe tzoa enam chashubim kissuy, ella im ken hem akurim sheen hatztzoa niret mittokam. Veen bittul haroq moil ella lepi shaa, abal im lo yiqra miyyad veharoq nimmoach venibla bah — lo betela:

Sapeq im tzoa babbayit — muttar liqrot, shechezqat bayit sheen bo tzoa. Sapeq im tzoa baashpa apillu im hu babbayit — asur, shechezqat ashpa sheyyesh bah tzoa. Vaapillu bemaqom [acher] shessapeq im yesh sham tzoa, kegon lipne habbattim shedderek lihyot sham tzoa — asur, vekol shekken bechatzer, ella im ken yadua sheen derek lihyot sham tzoa. Abal sepeq me raglayim — apillu baashpa muttar, mippene shello osra tora liqrot keneged me raglayim ella keneged ammud shel qilluach, abal leachar shennapelu laaretz muttar liqrot etzlan min hattora ap al pi shehem megullim, shenneemar: "veyad tihyeh leka michutz lammachaneh veyatzata shamma chutz". Velo hitzrikan kissuy kemo betzoa, shenneemar bah: "vekissita et tzeateka", ella shechakamim gazeru alehen gezera mishshum tzoa, velo gazeru ella bevaddaan — abal lo bispeqan:

Matza tzoa ben babbayit ben baashpa, vesapeq im hi tzoat adam o shel kelabim — tolin bammatzuy, ben lehaqel ben lehachamir, sheim metzuyin bah tinoqot yoter mikkelabim — apillu bebayit asur, veim apillu baashpa metzuyin kelabim yoter — tolin bakkelabim:

Qara qeriat shema o hitpallel bemaqom sherauy lehistappeq bo betzoa umetzaah sham achar kak — tzarik lachazor veliqrot ulehitpallel, lepi sheppasha bammeh shello badaq hammaqom qodem sheqqara o hitpallel, vahareni qore bo "vezebach reshaim toeba" (veim berek birkat hammazon o shear berakot — yitbaer besiman qp"h). Abal im en hammaqom rauy lehistappeq bo betzoa — en tzarik lachazor veliqrot ulehitpallel. Veim matza me raglayim apillu bimqom sherauy lehistappeq bahem — en tzarik lachazor veliqrot ulehitpallel, hoil veen issuran ella middibre soperim:
